_comment: Per-MODULE champion registry for the Ladrillo benchmark. Promotion is manual and
'tag' must have a frozen snapshot under benchmark/reference/<tag>/.
Champions are per module because a change that improves one module and leaves the
others untouched should not silently take credit for them.

ais.why: Floored glacier equilibrium + bounded regrowth replaces an unphysical melt-only ratchet (Marcus 2026-08-31). Adopts the position that the ratchet was manufacturing the old AIS amplification constraint: a 2x2 (L21/L22/L23/L23b) shows the law moves ais_gmst_amp 1.43 prior sd and AIS@2300 by 66 cm, against 4.93 cm between-refit reproducibility. Promoted 2026-09-01 with that attribution explicit and the identifiability question open.
ais.correction_2026-09-01: REFUTED 2026-09-01, the same day, and the `why` above is KEPT VERBATIM as the record of what was decided on what evidence. Two measurements retire its mechanism. (1) The glacier law is INERT in the calibration likelihood: old vs new differ by <=7.3e-05 in log-likelihood on L23-region draws, against 1.86 for a 1% wiggle of one glacier parameter and 11.4 for 1% of amp -- a null WITH power (scope_amp_likelihood_tilt.jl). D1 drops the total series, so glaciers and AIS have separate likelihood terms with no shared channel. (2) The 2x2 was NOT one variable: L23/L23b/L24 carry no --adcov and fell through to adapted_cov_L11tune3, where L21/L22 passed adapted_cov_L14tune; the AIS-block proposal is 2.7-5.3x TIGHTER in L23 and gis_s_high lands on its 0.05 floor (diag_proposal_seed_by_vintage.py, read from the runs' own seed_diag_*.txt). L23b is BLIND to this -- it shares the covariance and varied only RNG, so the 4.93 cm between-refit reproducibility yardstick was measured INSIDE the defect. The ordering of the L11 name map is CORRECT (fixed in 57959ee); this is an older tuning VINTAGE plus one unmapped parameter, NOT the L13 permutation. WHAT THE PROMOTION STILL RESTS ON: the floored-equilibrium law is a physical improvement Marcus asked for (2026-08-31), and L23 was accepted on the deliverable criterion. WHAT IT NO LONGER RESTS ON: any attribution of the ais_gmst_amp / AIS@2300 shift to the glacier law. L25 (L23's config + L21/L22's covariance) is the deciding run.
